purpose: One model-specific anonymous association scale proposal; not a known-person confidence calibration
nominal_baseline: Frozen Balanced normalized_joint, cues disabled, D0/E0 profile unchanged
nominal_E1: Retain unchanged inherited D0/E0 threshold profile as an explicitly uncalibrated E1 sensitivity condition

pair_admission.single_source_or_overlapping_waveform_pa: EXCLUDED; compare different original source IDs and different decoded PCM hashes only
pair_admission.representatives_per_source_and_evidence_: Sort by end_sample, start_sample; select unique indices 0, floor((n-1)/2), n-1 without consulting values or truth activity
pair_admission.missing_window_or_single_clip_identities: Retain explicit denominators and unavailable positive-pair status; never invent support

C_partition.unit: identity; all original source clips of one identity stay together
C_partition.rule: int(SHA256(UTF8(identity)) first 8 hex digits, 16) modulo 3 equals 0 -> validation; otherwise fit
C_partition.if_insufficient: UNAVAILABLE; do not change the split to improve the result

fit.pair_scores: Raw normalized-vector cosine; same exact waveform pairs for E0 and E1
fit.weighting: Median within each source-pair/role-pair, then median over source pairs for each identity-pair/role-pair, then median across present role-pairs per identity-pair, then median across identity-pair groups separately for same and different identities
fit.centers: n0,p0 are E0 different/same centers; n1,p1 are E1 different/same centers from fit partition only
fit.affine_mapping: slope=(p1-n1)/(p0-n0); intercept=n1-slope*n0; map E0 cosine threshold t to slope*t+intercept
fit.difference_mapping: Multiply by positive slope; no intercept
fit.unchanged: Normalized joint weights/margins, timing, evidence admission, lifecycle, dimensions, vector/prototype updates, inactive defaults, naming calibration and all E0 settings
fit.invalid_parameter_or_profile_validation: UNAVAILABLE; no clipping, extrapolation rescue or second parameter fit

validation.scoring: At each candidate cosine_threshold, report identity-group weighted same-pair rejection, different-pair acceptance and balanced mean; report all role-pair strata separately
validation.admission_rule: Candidate validation balanced mean <= E1 inherited nominal + 0.02 and different-pair acceptance <= E1 inherited nominal + 0.01; strict finite/group-support/profile validation must also pass
validation.uncertainty: Descriptive identity/source-correlated engineering calibration; no independent trial or deployment-confidence claim
validation.failure: Preserve proposal and failure; label UNQUALIFIED_C_SCALE; do not tune on validation or Q

integration_gates: Frozen new derivative with explicit E1 profile binding and score-unit metadata
Real tracker regression on C only before the full bank; source order is deterministic and resets between independent sequences
Reconfirm unchanged E0 baseline and common frontend/event policy
Keep operational processed-query naming Unknown without a separate valid domain-matched C gate
prohibited_claims: Improvement on unseen rooms or speakers
